question: Which world lies beyond the givers of yoga described earlier?
premises: There is a realm higher than those givers of yoga.
That realm belongs to the deity seated on the strands beginning with sattva.
That deity is Lord Śrīkaṇṭha, consort of the one mother of all worlds.
inference: Beyond the givers of yoga is the world of Lord Śrīkaṇṭha.
plain_english: Higher than them is the world of the god Lord Śrīkaṇṭha, who is seated on the strands beginning with sattva and is the lord of the one mother of the entire universe.
